text:
alex: Quick heads-up — ran the int3 quant bring-up for the new q3b-codegen variant and we see a measurable quality dip vs fp16 on our code generation prompt set. attaching short notes and a tiny repro.

maria: ugh, how big is the delta?

alex: overall synth BLEU-like metric dropped ~6 points on the canary set; on the microgolden of 120 code prompts 14 regressions where outputs truncated or missing imports.

dan: do we know if it's tokenizer mismatch or kv-cache/attention artifact under quant?

alex: initial diff looks model-side rather than tokenizer. most failures are early STOP tokens inserted. logs: ```
INPUT: def fetch(url):
...
OUTPUT_fp16: import requests
    r = requests.get(url)
OUTPUT_int3: import
```

olga: hmm sounds like quant cliff. We need a portable microgolden so we can compare int3 vs int4 vs fp16 across hardware. Current golden is tied to long prompts and has some duplicates.

sam: label-bot FYI: generating a triage list for those 14 regressions, will tag with "truncation", "missing-dependency", or "hallucinated-api".

label-bot: generated 14 items -> https://internal/labeler/triage/1718802222 (auto-tags applied).

maria: action items I see: 1) assemble portable microgolden (~200 samples) focusing on short code snippets that expose early-stop, 2) dedupe against existing golden and seedbank, 3) allocate 40 label hours to triage 200 samples, 4) run an eval harness across quant configs.

alex: I can push a small script to sample microgolden (diversity aware). snippet: ```bash
python -c "from sampling import diversity_sample; print(diversity_sample('code_prompts', n=200))"
# then run: ./eval_harness --model q3b-int3 --prompts microgolden.json --out results_int3.json
```

dan: for dedupe, use fuzzyhash threshold 0.85, also block near-identical function names. I'll add a lightweight fingerprint check to the script.

olga: labeling ops: we have 30 hours this week. Maria can you prioritize the 14 regressions first, then the sample curation? if we need more capacity we can slow other microgolden tasks.

maria: yep will re-prioritize. pinging @sam to confirm labeler availability.

sam: confirmed 30h -> can cover triage of 150 samples. if we end up with >200 I'll queue for next sprint.

alex: plan: I'll produce microgolden draft by EOD today (1718803600), push eval harness runs for int3/int4/fp16 tomorrow morning, then we reconvene to decide rollback vs quant-tuning.

dan: also add a quick quant-calibration run (1k steps) to check if fine-tune reduces early-stop. might be cheaper than falling back.

olga: timeline sounds good. please include a README in the microgolden dir with selection heuristics and dedupe pipeline.

maria: thanks — I'll update the ops ticket and tag eng-runtime for potential runtime masking if it's an execution artifact. :thumbsup:

alex: cc @eng-runtime for visibility. final note: keep the portable microgolden format plain newline-delimited JSONL with fields: "id", "prompt", "expected_snippet", "labels[]". we want this portable across eval harnesses and on-prem.

label-bot: noted. triage doc updated, assigning items 1-14 -> olga, alex, dan.

sam: adding a quick runner command for ops: ```bash
./eval_harness --models q3b-int3,q3b-int4,q3b-fp16 --prompts microgolden.jsonl --metrics trunc_rate,bleu_like --outdir /tmp/evals/1718802222
```

alex: perfect. will post results link in this thread when done. thanks all. :rocket:
